Reading Library Flagship

Classroom Tools

Class & Roster

Enter your students once. Every dialogue in the lab will instantly cast them as speakers and balance the turns.

Student names

One name per line, or separate with commas. Supports 1 to 100+ students.

How it works

Open any dialogue in the library. The speakers are automatically replaced by your students. If you have more students than roles, turns are redistributed so everyone participates. Fewer students? Roles are shared fairly. Hit Shuffle in the reader for a fresh casting every time.
